jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 700 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Tax departments.

You will be part of the Finance – Group Corporate Services team within the Finance department.

Your role

As a member of the Finance team, you will be responsible for financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting, and for providing insightful advice to senior management. This position requires strong analytical skills and close collaboration across departments to ensure financial and analytical processes are robust and relevant, supporting strategic decision-making and the Group’s financial initiatives.

You will be in charge of:

• Delivering monthly financial results to senior management on time, together with business metrics and supporting in-depth analyses of the GCS division’s cost drivers.

• Contributing meaningfully to the Group’s budgeting and forecasting processes, including business and financial modelling, the multi-year plan, variance analysis and performance reviews.

• Developing reports and data visualisation tools that highlight key elements and drivers of financial performance and make complex data accessible and actionable.

• Developing a deep understanding of Pictet GCS’s costs allocation mechanisms to business lines.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather financial data, develop analyses and support decision-making.

• Conducting targeted financial and strategic analysis to identify trends, business and cost drivers as well as opportunities for improvement.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

• At least 2–5 years’ experience in financial analysis, controlling or a related role.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle complex financial issues.

• A sense of urgency, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Proficiency in data management and visualisation tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau and Snowflake.

• Proficiency in using advanced digital and AI-powered tools (including generative AI) to enhance financial analysis, automate recurring tasks and improve the quality and efficiency of reporting.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.

• Fluency in French and English is essential.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the successful candidate, you will be expected to apply strong analytical skills, demonstrate initiative and collaborate effectively within a dynamic team. You will also be keen to embrace the Group’s values and consistently put them into practice in your daily activities.

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

La tua squadra

Le funzioni aziendali includono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 700 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali, e includono comunicazioni, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, ufficio aziendale, rischi e dipartimenti fiscali.

Sarai parte del team Finance – Group Corporate Services all'interno del dipartimento Finance.

Il tuo ruolo

Come membro del team Finance, sarai responsabile per l'analisi finanziaria, il budgeting, la previsione e la rendicontazione delle prestazioni, e per fornire consigli approfonditi alla gestione senior. Questa posizione richiede forti competenze analitiche e una stretta collaborazione tra i dipartimenti per garantire che i processi finanziari e analitici siano robusti e rilevanti, supportando il processo decisionale strategico e le iniziative finanziarie del Gruppo.

Lei sarà responsabile di:

• Fornire risultati finanziari mensili a senior management nel tempo, insieme a metriche aziendali e sostenere analisi approfondite dei driver di costo della divisione GCS.

• Contribuire significativamente ai processi di bilancio e di previsione del Gruppo, tra cui la modellazione aziendale e finanziaria, il piano pluriennale, l’analisi delle variazioni e le recensioni delle prestazioni.

• Sviluppare report e strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati che evidenziano elementi chiave e driver delle prestazioni finanziarie e rendono accessibili e attuabili i dati complessi.

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei meccanismi di allocazione dei costi di Pictet GCS alle linee di business.

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per raccogliere dati finanziari, sviluppare analisi e sostenere il processo decisionale.

• Condurre analisi finanziarie e strategiche mirate per identificare tendenze, business e costi, nonché opportunità di miglioramento.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale o equivalente in finanza, contabilità, economia o un campo correlato.

• Almeno 2-5 anni di esperienza nell’analisi finanziaria, nel controllo o in un ruolo correlato.

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di affrontare questioni finanziarie complesse.

• Un senso di urgenza, forti capacità di problem solving e la capacità di gestire più priorità e rispettare le scadenze.

• La competenza nella gestione dei dati e strumenti di visualizzazione come Excel, Power BI, Tableau e Snowflake.

• La competenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti digitali e basati su AI avanzati (inclusa l'IA generativa) per migliorare l'analisi finanziaria, automatizzare i compiti ricorrenti e migliorare la qualità e l'efficienza della segnalazione.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di presentare informazioni complesse in modo chiaro e conciso.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e impegno a fornire un lavoro di alta qualità.

• Capacità di lavorare sia indipendentemente che come parte di un team in un ambiente dinamico.

• La fluidità in francese e inglese è essenziale.

• Deve essere residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi.

Come candidato di successo, ci si aspetta di applicare forti competenze analitiche, dimostrare l'iniziativa e collaborare efficacemente all'interno di un team dinamico. Sarete inoltre desiderosi di abbracciare i valori del Gruppo e metterli costantemente in pratica nelle vostre attività quotidiane.

Dein Team

Corporate Functions umfasst die Nichtbankaktivitäten der Gruppe und beschäftigt mehr als 700 Mitarbeiter. Diese Funktionen werden von Spezialisten mit Fachwissen in allen Geschäftsbereichen ausgeführt und umfassen Kommunikation, Compliance, Finanzen, Personal, Informationssicherheit, interne Revision, Recht, Corporate Office, Risiko- und Steuerabteilungen.

Sie werden Teil des Finance – Group Corporate Services Teams innerhalb der Finanzabteilung.

Deine Rolle

Als Mitglied des Finanzteams sind Sie für die Finanzanalyse, Budgetierung, Prognose und Leistungsberichterstattung sowie für eine aufschlussreiche Beratung des oberen Managements verantwortlich. Diese Position erfordert starke analytische Fähigkeiten und eine enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Abteilungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Finanz- und Analyseprozesse robust und relevant sind und die strategischen Entscheidungen und die finanziellen Initiativen der Gruppe unterstützen.

Sie sind verantwortlich für:

• Bereitstellung monatlicher Finanzergebnisse an die Geschäftsleitung rechtzeitig, zusammen mit Geschäftskennzahlen und Unterstützung eingehender Analysen der Kostentreiber der GCS-Division.

• Beitrag zu den Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozessen der Gruppe, einschließlich Geschäfts- und Finanzmodellierung, Mehrjahresplan, Varianzanalyse und Leistungsüberprüfungen.

• Entwicklung von Berichten und Datenvisualisierungstools, die wichtige Elemente und Treiber der finanziellen Performance hervorheben und komplexe Daten zugänglich und umsetzbar machen.

• Entwicklung eines tiefen Verständnisses der Kostenverteilungsmechanismen von Pictet GCS für Geschäftsbereiche.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um Finanzdaten zu sammeln, Analysen zu entwickeln und die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

• Durchführen gezielter finanzieller und strategischer Analysen zur Identifizierung von Trends, Geschäfts- und Kostentreibern sowie Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten.

Dein Profil

• Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertig in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Mindestens 2-5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Finanzanalyse, Controlling oder eine verwandte Rolle.

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe finanzielle Probleme anzugehen.

• Ein Gefühl der Dringlichkeit, starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu bewältigen und Fristen einzuhalten.

• Kenntnisse in Datenmanagement- und Visualisierungstools wie Excel, Power BI, Tableau und Snowflake.

• Kenntnisse im Einsatz fortschrittlicher digitaler und KI-gestützter Tools (einschließlich generativer KI), um die Finanzanalyse zu verbessern, wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren und die Qualität und Effizienz der Berichterstattung zu verbessern.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen klar und prägnant darzustellen.

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und eine Verpflichtung, qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit zu liefern.

• Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch als Teil eines Teams in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten.

• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch ist unerlässlich.

• Muss in der Schweiz ansässig oder bereit sein, umzuziehen.

Als erfolgreicher Kandidat wird von Ihnen erwartet, dass Sie starke analytische Fähigkeiten anwenden, Initiative zeigen und effektiv in einem dynamischen Team zusammenarbeiten. Sie werden auch daran interessiert sein, die Werte der Gruppe zu umarmen und sie in Ihren täglichen Aktivitäten konsequent umzusetzen.

Votre équipe

Les fonctions corporatives comprennent les activités non bancaires du Groupe et emploient plus de 700 personnes. Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes spécialisés dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, des services juridiques, du bureau des sociétés, des services des risques et de l'impôt.

Vous ferez partie de l'équipe des Services ministériels du groupe Finances au sein du ministère des Finances.

Votre rôle

En tant que membre de l'équipe des Finances, vous serez responsable de l'analyse financière, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et des rapports sur le rendement, et de la prestation de conseils éclairés à la haute direction. Ce poste exige de solides compétences analytiques et une collaboration étroite entre les ministères pour s'assurer que les processus financiers et analytiques sont solides et pertinents, appuyant la prise de décisions stratégiques et les initiatives financières du Groupe.

Vous serez en charge de:

• Fournir à temps des résultats financiers mensuels à la haute direction, ainsi que des paramètres opérationnels et appuyer des analyses approfondies des facteurs de coûts de la division GCS.

• Contribution significative aux processus de budgétisation et de prévision du Groupe, y compris la modélisation opérationnelle et financière, le plan pluriannuel, l ' analyse des écarts et les études de performance.

• Élaborer des rapports et des outils de visualisation des données qui mettent en évidence les éléments clés et les moteurs de la performance financière et rendent les données complexes accessibles et exploitables.

• Développer une compréhension approfondie des mécanismes de répartition des coûts de Pictet GCS pour les secteurs d'activité.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour recueillir des données financières, élaborer des analyses et appuyer la prise de décisions.

• Effectuer une analyse financière et stratégique ciblée afin de cerner les tendances, les facteurs de coûts et les possibilités d'amélioration.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise ou équivalent en finance, comptabilité, économie ou un domaine connexe.

• Au moins 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans l'analyse financière, le contrôle ou un rôle connexe.

• Des compétences analytiques solides avec la capacité de s'attaquer à des questions financières complexes.

• Un sentiment d'urgence, des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les délais.

• Connaissance des outils de gestion des données et de visualisation tels qu'Excel, Power BI, Tableau et Snowflake.

• Compétence dans l'utilisation d'outils numériques et d'IA avancés (y compris l'IA génératrice) pour améliorer l'analyse financière, automatiser les tâches récurrentes et améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité des rapports.

• Excellentes compétences en communication avec la capacité de présenter des informations complexes de façon claire et concise.

• Une grande attention aux détails et un engagement à fournir un travail de haute qualité.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe dans un environnement dynamique.

• La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est essentielle.

• Doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager.

En tant que candidat reçu, vous devrez utiliser de solides compétences analytiques, faire preuve d'initiative et collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe dynamique. Vous serez également désireux d'embrasser les valeurs du Groupe et de les mettre systématiquement en pratique dans vos activités quotidiennes.

Remarque

Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire des agences.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

You will join our Technology team for a six-month assignment, helping clients and internal users make effective use of our business applications. Working with product, business and technical teams, you will combine functional support, user training and continuous improvement.

Your role

• Provide functional support, investigate user issues, assess their business impact and document them in Jira.
• Coordinate incident follow-up with application owners and technical teams, keeping users informed through to resolution.
• Assist users with access requests through established approval processes.
• Deliver application training, maintain user documentation and support release communications and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Analyse recurring issues and user feedback to recommend improvements to applications, support processes and monitoring.
• Follow up on enhancement requests with Product Managers, who retain responsibility for prioritisation.
• Maintain documentation and handover records to ensure service continuity.

Your profile

• Experience in functional application support or incident coordination.
• Ability to understand business applications, investigate issues methodically and explain functionality clearly.
• Familiarity with Jira or a comparable ticketing tool.
• Analytical skills and a practical approach to improving processes.
• Organisational skills, clear communication and a service-oriented mindset.
• French at C2 level and English at B2 level, both written and spoken.
• Experience in user training, UAT or financial services would be an advantage.
• Must be resident in Switzerland

Pictet Tech designs, builds, and operates the technology that underpins the Group’s core activities, from portfolio management and trading to banking services. Within Data Platforms, our ambition is to build a modern, resilient, and scalable data foundation across the Group. We are transforming our technology landscape by combining cloud and on-premise strengths, modernizing how data is stored, processed, integrated, and distributed, and raising engineering standards across all domains. You will join a team at the centre of this transformation, helping turn complex challenges into secure, reliable, and high-performing capabilities that enable teams to deliver faster and with greater confidence.
As a Technical Architect, you will drive the cloud transformation of the Group’s data platforms. You will define hybrid target architectures and lead the migration of data, processing workloads, and data flows from on-premise environments to the cloud, balancing innovation with security, resilience, and operational continuity. Working closely with domain leads, you will turn strategy into clear technology choices and pragmatic roadmaps, accelerating the shift from legacy platforms to modern cloud-native services.
You will also act as a senior engineering leader across data domains, solving complex challenges, guiding critical technical decisions, and raising engineering standards. Your role is to strengthen teams and ensure the delivery of scalable, maintainable, and operationally robust solutions.

Your role

• Shape ambitious hybrid and cloud architectures with domain leads, while keeping clear ownership of decisions and delivery.
• Guide migration strategies for on-premise databases, processing workloads, and data flows to the cloud, with strong standards for security, resilience, performance, operability, and cost efficiency.
• Define reusable patterns for data integration and processing across APIs, batch, CDC, streaming, and messaging.
• Provide hands-on support to solve complex issues, validate architecture choices, and build reference implementations teams can own.
• Lead by example through coding, design reviews, automation, and troubleshooting to raise standards and strengthen team capability.
• Ensure solutions meet high architectural and operational standards for automation, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.

• Strong experience in software, platform, cloud or reliability engineering, or technical architecture, delivering complex production systems.
• Hands-on skills in software design, coding, automation, testing, CI/CD, observability, and troubleshooting.
• Deep knowledge of distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, infrastructure, networking, security, reliability, and performance.
